verdict.rationale: Portkey's AI Gateway docs state that it can connect to remote MCP servers to bring in external tools and data sources, so this is a first-party capability. The evidence is a single one-line feature mention, with no setup, configuration or tool-invocation detail. Missing for 10: documented MCP server registration/configuration steps, evidence of how tools are exposed to and called by models through the gateway, support for local/stdio MCP servers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Connect to Remote MCP severs, allowing you to connect external tools and data sources.
